description_en: This operation submits a transcoding job. You can use this operation if the transcoding tasks or workflows created in the console do not meet your requirements. You can configure the required transcoding parameters based on your business logic
description_zh: 提交转码作业。当控制台创建的转码任务和工作流均无法满足您的使用场景时，可以按需调用SubmitJobs接口进行转码。根据您的业务逻辑配置所需的转码参数即可

name: SubmitJobs

parameters.example: {"Bucket":"exampleBucket","Location":"oss-cn-hangzhou","Object":"example.flv","Referer": "The anti-hotlinking parameter configured on the OSS console"}
parameters.help_en:
Job input. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

In ApsaraVideo Media Processing APIs, the Object value must be URL-encoded using UTF-8 encoding.

The OSS region must match the region where MPS is deployed
parameters.help_zh:
作业输入。详细说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

在媒体处理API中，Object必须经过URL Encoding（基于UTF-8编码）后使用。
OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
Job output configurations. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

Outputs is a JSON array of Output objects. The maximum size is 30
parameters.help_zh:
作业输出配置。详细说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。
Outputs由Output列表构成，JSON数组，大小上限为30
parameters.name: outputs

parameters.help_en:
The OSS bucket where output files are stored.

Follows the OSS bucket definition. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31827.html
parameters.help_zh:
输出文件所在的OSS Bucket。
遵守OSS Bucket定义，更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31827.html
parameters.name: output_bucket

parameters.help_en:
The OSS region (OSS Region) where the output bucket resides.

The OSS bucket must be in the same region as the ApsaraVideo Media Processing service.

Follows the OSS bucket definition. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31827.html
parameters.help_zh:
输出文件所在的OSS Bucket的地域（OSS Region）。
OSS Bucket必须与媒体处理服务在同一个地域。
遵守OSS Bucket定义，更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31827.html
parameters.name: output_location

parameters.help_en:
The pipeline ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31827.html.

You can find it in the MPS console (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) > Settings > Pipelines and callbacks.

To receive asynchronous notifications, bind an MNS message topic to the pipeline. For details, see <props="china">Receive message notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">Receive message notifications (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
管道ID。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31827.html。

可以通过MPS控制台 (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) > 全局设置 > 管道及回调查询。

如果需要异步通知，请为管道绑定MNS消息。详细操作，请参见<props="china">接收消息通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">接收消息通知 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>
parameters.name: pipeline_id
